blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur—Anti-narcotics agents and naval intelligence personnel seized around one kilo of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) worth an estimated P6.8 million. The confiscation was done during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Tugbungan, Zamboanga City Friday afternoon, Oct. 23. The joint law enforcement operation, conducted at 2:15 p.m., also led to the arrest of a 35-year-old high-value drug personality, according to authorities. The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency Regional Office 9 (PDEA RO9), led by its Regional Special Enforcement Team 1, executed the operation.
